behind_him.how: tools/matte.swift cuts him out (Vision person segmentation); tools/build-from-schedule.py --behind lays the cut-out over the finished composite, so a card that reaches behind his head is hidden by him.
behind_him.dx_dy: Moves a clip on the 2560x1440 frame (dx right, dy down). Animations do not all sit in the same spot: vary side, height and tuck. Keep words clear of the face box (x 935-1760, y 400-1220 on this video) and above the caption band (y 1170); let only decoration (cash stacks, card margins) go behind him.
